title: /mcp/authorities/{id}/sender_constraint/replay_store — configuration field
bodyMarkdown:
## Purpose

Select local_persistent protected nonce/replay state for one replica. Do not copy/reset state or assume multi-host coordination.

## Constraints and authority

Public schema path: `/mcp/authorities/{id}/sender_constraint/replay_store`. fixed value: "local_persistent". Branch-specific requirements and native permission/identity checks still apply; schema input acceptance alone is not authority. Use synthetic declarations in the preview and keep credential bytes outside policy.

## Expected result

The local proposal contains the intended declaration and passes complete-policy validation. Browser Save retains a local draft; it does not activate native configuration, fetch a provider value or grant remote access. Use the corresponding guide for actual native operations.

## Recovery

On denial, verify the exact issuer/client/subject, resource, grant, scopes/roles and active window. Do not widen a grant or reset DPoP replay state as a connection workaround.
capabilityStatus: A declared configuration field; browser editing is local. Actual native behavior depends on the selected schema/runtime, adapter and authorization.
